Hello,

I hope you are doing well.

I am contacting you regarding the flat listed in the link below. We are looking to move in on August 25th.

Could you please clarify how the rent will be calculated for our first month? Specifically, would we be required to pay for the full month of August, or will the rent be prorated to cover only the days from our move-in date?

Thank you for your time and assistance.
